scenarios.title: Zero facts from standup boilerplate + ungrounded candidate claim
review_required_items: Confirm 0-fact threshold for pure scheduling/boilerplate notes
scenarios.rationale: Meeting logistics chatter contains no career accomplishments; candidate claim has 0 fact supports and must remain UNSUPPORTED.

scenarios.title: Single fact clean individual delivery baseline
review_required_items: T-004B human confirmation of baseline SOURCE_VERIFIED criteria
scenarios.rationale: Single unambiguous PR authored by verified owner directly supports the single claim atom.

scenarios.title: Multiple (N=3) facts from Korean postmortem with multi-byte UTF-8 offsets
review_required_items: Confirm multi-atom aggregation rule when all N atoms have DIRECT support
scenarios.rationale: Three distinct bullet items yield 3 canonical facts and 3 supported claim atoms in one composite claim.

scenarios.title: DIRECT+CONTEXT grounding vs CONTEXT-only insufficient grounding
review_required_items: Confirm CONTEXT-only claims map to UNSUPPORTED (not PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED)
scenarios.rationale: Background initiative goal provides CONTEXT only and cannot independently verify a claim of 100% problem elimination.

scenarios.title: CONTRADICTS across initial incident draft and corrected postmortem addendum
review_required_items: Confirm conflict precedence policy when a newer addendum contradicts an older draft
scenarios.rationale: Unresolved CONTRADICTS support prevents SOURCE_VERIFIED on the zero-drop claim while allowing verification of the corrected log-audit claim.

scenarios.title: Completed delivery vs planned Q4 RFC work (Korean)
review_required_items: Confirm planned-as-completed maps to CONFLICTING vs UNSUPPORTED
scenarios.rationale: Future plan statements cannot verify a completed-delivery claim, while the completed health-check item is directly supported.

scenarios.title: Negation context (not deployed, reverted, cost savings not achieved)
review_required_items: Verify negation reversal handling in Fact/Claim rubric
scenarios.rationale: Explicit negation refutes positive deployment/savings claims while supporting the accurate rollback claim.

scenarios.title: Team achievement vs individual contribution attribution
review_required_items: Confirm attribution rubric for team-level metrics referenced as CONTEXT
scenarios.rationale: Individual cache layer work is DIRECT-supported; solo-rebuilt CI pipeline overclaim lacks DIRECT individual support.

scenarios.title: Staging/test benchmark vs unstarted production deployment (Korean)
review_required_items: Confirm environment-scope mismatch triggers CONFLICTING when production non-deployment is explicit
scenarios.rationale: Staging benchmark results cannot be elevated to production impact claims when production rollout has not started.

scenarios.title: Unverified causation and fabricated metric in a 3-atom partial claim
review_required_items: Confirm causal attribution bar when confounders exist and no A/B test was run
scenarios.rationale: Only 1 of 3 atoms (launch date) is supported; unverified revenue causation and fabricated 45% conversion lift keep the claim PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.

scenarios.title: Identity ambiguity (unmapped homonym 'Alex') vs verified account author
review_required_items: Confirm identity resolution threshold before allowing SOURCE_VERIFIED
scenarios.rationale: Unmapped display name 'Alex' shared by two team members blocks automatic SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: User edit invalidation (substantive inflation and minor paraphrase)
review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm whether minor paraphrase edits (claim-12-2) also invalidate SOURCE_VERIFIED until re-verified
scenarios.rationale: User-edited claims must never remain automatically SOURCE_VERIFIED without re-verification.

scenarios.title: User source deletion cascading to full invalidation and partial-atom invalidation
review_required_items: Confirm deleted source cascade state naming (INVALIDATED_BY_DELETION vs UNSUPPORTED)
scenarios.rationale: Deleting src13a invalidates fact-13-1, fully invalidating claim-13-1 and downgrading multi-atom claim-13-2 to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.

scenarios.title: Hard negatives bundle: 10x numeric distortion and cross-project conflation
review_required_items: Confirm claim status precedence when a multi-atom claim has both CONTRADICTED and UNSUPPORTED atoms
scenarios.rationale: Despite 1 supported anchor atom, 400ms->40ms distortion and Alpha/Borealis conflation force CONFLICTING (never SOURCE_VERIFIED).
